---
title: "04.Taxa_ARG"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-10-20"
output: html_document
---

Taxa associated with the resistome: ARG load, richness and Simpson diversity.

* ARG metrics from `Data/Processed/arg_metrics.tsv` (same values as parts 0 and 1), standardised (z).
* One MaAsLin2 model per ARG metric at species and genus level:
  taxon ~ ARG metric (z) + diet group + sex + age + BMI + log10 depth.
  Coefficients are the change in log2 relative abundance per 1-SD increase of the ARG metric,
  independently of diet group.
* Same MaAsLin2 settings as `03.Taxa_by_diet.Rmd`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(phyloseq)
library(Maaslin2)

table_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Tables")
plot_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Plots")
maaslin_dir <- here("2.-Microbiome", "Results", "Maaslin2")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(maaslin_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# Load data

```{r load data}
ps <- readRDS(here("Data", "Processed", "phyloseq_species.rds"))
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))

arg_metrics <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_metrics.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

arg_labels <- c(
  "log_ARG_load" = "ARG load",
  "richness"     = "ARG richness",
  "simpson"      = "ARG Simpson")

metadata_maaslin <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame") %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  left_join(arg_metrics, by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = c("Omnivore", "Vegetarian", "Vegan")),
         across(all_of(names(arg_labels)), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x)), .names = "{.col}_z")) %>%
  column_to_rownames("sample_id")
```


# MaAsLin2

```{r maaslin function}
abundance_table <- function(rank) {
  ps_rank <- if (rank == "Species") ps_rel else tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = rank, NArm = FALSE)
  abundance <- as(otu_table(ps_rank), "matrix")
  taxa <- as(tax_table(ps_rank), "matrix")[, rank]
  key <- tibble(feature = sprintf("%s_%04d", rank, seq_along(taxa)), taxon = unname(taxa))
  rownames(abundance) <- key$feature
  list(data = as.data.frame(t(abundance)), key = key)
}

run_maaslin_arg <- function(rank, arg_metric) {
  input <- abundance_table(rank)
  arg_z <- paste0(arg_metric, "_z")

  fit <- Maaslin2(
    input_data = input$data,
    input_metadata = metadata_maaslin,
    output = file.path(maaslin_dir, paste0("ARG_", arg_metric, "_", rank)),
    fixed_effects = c(arg_z, "diet_group", "sex", "age", "bmi", "log10_depth"),
    reference = "diet_group,Omnivore",
    normalization = "NONE",
    transform = "LOG",
    min_prevalence = 0.1,
    min_abundance = 0,
    standardize = FALSE,
    plot_heatmap = FALSE,
    plot_scatter = FALSE)

  fit$results %>%
    filter(metadata == arg_z) %>%
    left_join(input$key, by = "feature") %>%
    mutate(rank = rank, arg_metric = arg_metric, endpoint = arg_labels[arg_metric]) %>%
    relocate(rank, endpoint, taxon)
}
```

```{r maaslin}
arg_results <- expand_grid(rank = c("Species", "Genus"), arg_metric = names(arg_labels)) %>%
  pmap_dfr(run_maaslin_arg) %>%
  as_tibble()

arg_results %>%
  filter(qval < 0.25) %>%
  count(rank, endpoint, direction = if_else(coef > 0, "positive", "negative"), name = "n_taxa")
```

```{r top associations}
arg_results %>%
  filter(qval < 0.05) %>%
  select(rank, endpoint, taxon, coef, stderr, pval, qval) %>%
  arrange(endpoint, qval) %>%
  print(n = 60)
```


# Heatmap

Species with q < 0.25 for at least one ARG metric (top 40 by smallest q).

```{r heatmap}
top_species <- arg_results %>%
  filter(rank == "Species", qval < 0.25) %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(min_q = min(qval), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_min(min_q, n = 40, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(taxon)

heatmap_data <- arg_results %>%
  filter(rank == "Species", taxon %in% top_species) %>%
  mutate(endpoint = factor(endpoint, levels = unname(arg_labels)),
         q_label = case_when(qval < 0.001 ~ "***", qval < 0.01 ~ "**", qval < 0.05 ~ "*",
                             qval < 0.25 ~ "·", TRUE ~ ""))

# Order species by their coefficient profile
species_order <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(taxon, endpoint, coef) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = endpoint, values_from = coef, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("taxon") %>%
  dist() %>%
  hclust() %>%
  { .$labels[.$order] }

coef_limit <- max(abs(heatmap_data$coef))

plot_heatmap <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = species_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = endpoint, y = taxon, fill = coef)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = q_label), size = 3.5, vjust = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2864A5", mid = "white", high = "#A23E48", midpoint = 0,
                       limits = c(-coef_limit, coef_limit), name = "Coefficient\n(per 1 SD)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       subtitle = "· q < 0.25, * q < 0.05, ** q < 0.01, *** q < 0.001") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

plot_heatmap
```


# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(arg_results, file.path(table_dir, "maaslin2_taxa_ARG.tsv"))

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "Taxa_ARG_heatmap.png"), plot_heatmap, width = 6.5,
       height = max(5, 0.2 * length(top_species) + 1.5), dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
